teaser.en: The only member of its genus: a glossy-leaved, sweet-scented shrub of the dry coastal country.
teaser.sw: Spishi pekee katika jenasi yake: kichaka chenye majani yanayong'aa na harufu tamu, cha maeneo makavu ya pwani.

summary.en: Mtsome is Lamprothamnus zanguebaricus, an evergreen shrub or small tree of the coffee family found only from southern Somalia to Tanzania. Pakia records only its Digo name.
summary.sw: Mtsome ni Lamprothamnus zanguebaricus, kichaka au mti mdogo wenye majani ya kijani mwaka mzima, wa familia ya mibuni (kahawa), unaopatikana tu kuanzia kusini mwa Somalia hadi Tanzania. Pakia anarekodi jina lake la Kidigo tu.

about.en: Mtsome is an evergreen shrub or tree up to about 9 m tall, with fissured or corrugated bark. Its leaves are oblong, glossy and rather leathery, with raised veins and often a slightly heart-shaped base. The flowers are sweetly scented. It is the only species in its genus.
about.sw: Mtsome ni kichaka au mti wenye majani ya kijani mwaka mzima, wenye kimo cha hadi takriban mita 9, na gome lenye nyufa au mikunjo. Majani yake ni marefu ya mstatili, yanayong'aa na magumu kiasi kama ngozi, yenye mishipa iliyoinuka na mara nyingi kitako chenye umbo la moyo kidogo. Maua yana harufu tamu. Ndiyo spishi pekee katika jenasi yake.

where.en: It grows in the seasonally dry coastal bushland and forest of southern Somalia, Kenya and Tanzania.
where.sw: Huota katika vichaka na misitu ya pwani yenye ukame wa msimu, kusini mwa Somalia, Kenya na Tanzania.

names.en: Pakia records the Digo name Mtsome but gives no meaning or shared names. Its scientific name is Lamprothamnus zanguebaricus; zanguebaricus refers to Zanguebar, the old name for the Zanzibar coast.
names.sw: Pakia anarekodi jina la Kidigo Mtsome lakini hatoi maana yake wala majina yanayoshirikiwa na lugha nyingine. Jina lake la kisayansi ni Lamprothamnus zanguebaricus; zanguebaricus linarejelea Zanguebar, jina la zamani la pwani ya Zanzibar.

reason.en: Similar-sounding name next to it in Pakia's list
reason.sw: Jina linalosikika vivyo hivyo, lililo karibu nalo katika orodha ya Pakia

reason.en: Another shrub of the coffee family
reason.sw: Kichaka kingine cha familia ya mibuni (kahawa)
